message:
You know, I used to think my neighbor Martha was a bit over-the-top with her emergency supplies. I mean, who really needs a year's worth of canned beans and enough batteries to power a small town? But when that unexpected winter storm hit last month and we were snowed in for days, I found myself knocking on her door, asking if she had any hot cocoa mix to spare. 

Turns out, being gloriously over-prepared has its perks! I’ve since taken a page from Martha’s book and tucked away a few extra snacks and supplies. Just in case. 

What about you? Any tips for being just the right amount of prepared?
